questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are entering or approaching a school zone or school crossing. Slow down and watch for children near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers that animals, people, or vehicles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that traffic is coming from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign warns drivers that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on a vehicle shows it travels at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork machines, or horse-drawn wagons. The sign appears as a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Multiple chevron signs may mark a sharp curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only flows one way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic and only complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign alerts drivers to a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that wet roads are slippery. Slow down when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. Watch for orange signs, cones, and barrels. This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is attached to slow-moving vehicles to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the maximum legal speed. In rain, snow, ice, or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead. They are usually yellow diamonds with black symbols or words.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down and be ready for a sudden change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes extra slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a school crossing is ahead. Watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It means drivers turning left on a green light do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to drive around a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance from the wrong direction. If you see this sign, turn around. Traffic is coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be alert because a side road is crossing ahead.
